title: PANDA Robotics USA Recognized in 2025 TITAN Innovation Awards: Season 2 for Excellence in Robotic Technology
author: PROMATION Inc.
excerpt: The 2025 TITAN Innovation Awards has officially announced the winners of Season 2, celebrating outstanding achievements in technology, design, and digital transformation. Through honoring PANDA Robotics USA as a 3-Time Gold Winner in the category of Robotic Technology, Automation Technology, and Manufacturing Technology.
body:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

**PANDA Robotics USA Recognized in 2025 TITAN Innovation Awards: Season 2 for Excellence in Robotic Technology**

Kenosha, Wisconsin – November 11, 2025 – The 2025 TITAN Innovation Awards has officially announced the winners of Season 2, celebrating outstanding achievements in technology, design, and digital transformation. Through honoring PANDA Robotics USA as a 3-Time Gold Winner in the category of Robotic Technology, Automation Technology, and Manufacturing Technology, these awards continue their mission to recognize technologies and ideas that drive progress, elevate user experience, and strengthen industries across the globe.

In its third year, the award received over 5,500 entries from more than 40 countries, reinforcing its position as one of the leading international competitions for innovation and design excellence. The diversity of submissions highlights the TITAN Awards' role in recognizing organizations that redefine the boundaries of performance, creativity, and impact.

## Winning Entry Details

- **Entry Title:** PANDA 460 Series Laser Marking Machine
- **Location:** Kenosha, Wisconsin, USA
- **Company / Individual:** PANDA Robotics USA
- **Industry Impact:** Electronics Manufacturing & Smart Factory Automation
- **Explore More:** www.panda-usa.com/panda-laser-marking

## Winner's Statement

Michael Thomas Goldberg, Co-Founder and Lead Designer (PANDA ROBOTICS USA) stated: "We are deeply honored to receive the TITAN Innovation of Design Award for our PANDA 460 Series Laser Marking System. This recognition celebrates more than aesthetics — it affirms our belief that intelligent engineering and purposeful design can coexist beautifully. Every contour, motion, and detail of the PANDA 460 was created to inspire confidence and elevate automation for the modern factory. To be recognized on a global stage reinforces our mission to design machines that perform with precision — and feel legendary."

Thomas Brandt, spokesperson of International Awards Associate (IAA), remarked: "This season's winners showcase how innovation is best recognized when delivering impactful outcomes. PANDA Robotics recognition in TITAN reflects a standard of quality that defines this award and strengthens its place within the global industry."

## About PANDA Robotics USA

PANDA Robotics USA forges the future of automation through design, precision, and vision. From the recently award-winning PANDA 460 Laser Marking System to the most awarded soldering robot in the world: the PANDA 600 Series Intelligent Robotic Soldering System; every creation embodies mastery in motion. Born from a legacy of engineering excellence, the company redefines what world-class automation feels like — building machines that command respect, elevate craftsmanship, and set new standards for the electronics manufacturing industry.

## About TITAN Innovation Awards

The TITAN Innovation Awards is an international program honoring excellence in technology, design, and innovation that influences global industries. From startups to established organizations, the awards recognize submissions that demonstrate originality, efficiency, and transformative impact — shaping the next era of industrial and digital progress.

title: The Next Generation of Laser Marking by PANDA ROBOTICS USA
author: PROMATION Inc.
excerpt: PROMATION USA announces the launch of its next-generation PANDA Laser Marking System designed for precision in PCB and component marking. The PANDA-460 Laser Marking Cell accommodates KEYENCE laser heads and offers unmatched flexibility for a wide range of substrates and applications.
body:
**PROMATION USA Launches Next-Generation PANDA Laser Marking System – Setting a New Standard in Electronics Manufacturing Automation**

Kenosha, WI — October 2025 — PROMATION USA, a leading designer and manufacturer of advanced automation solutions for the electronics and micro-electronics industries, proudly announces the launch of its next-generation PANDA Laser Marking System — a precision-engineered platform that redefines speed, intelligence, and versatility in PCB and component marking applications.

Developed by PROMATION's Robotics Division, the new PANDA-460 Laser Marking Cell represents a major leap forward in traceability and process automation. Designed to accommodate any of the KEYENCE laser heads (CO₂, YV04, or UV), the system offers unmatched flexibility for a wide range of substrates and applications — all within a standard work envelope powered by Windows 11 and PROMATION-developed I/O and motion-control cards.

"There are plenty of good laser markers out there — but very few great ones. The PANDA-460 was engineered to close that gap," stated Michael Thomas Goldberg, Vice President of PROMATION USA.

Leveraging PROMATION's proprietary software architecture, engineers can remotely access and control every aspect of the machine — from programming adjustments and data-transmission speeds to diagnostic review and corrective actions — ensuring maximum uptime and minimal maintenance.

The PANDA system also integrates a high-performance vision-alignment platform, orientation validation, code verification, and double-sided PCB marking, making it one of the most feature-rich solutions on the market. The thoughtful design emphasizes operator experience, delivering an intuitive interface without sacrificing technological sophistication.

Gary Goldberg, President and CEO of PROMATION USA, noted that "It combines the precision and repeatability that engineers expect with the usability that production teams require."

The PANDA-460 isn't just a standalone solution — it's fully compatible with PROMATION's growing family of Smart Factory-ready systems, including robotic soldering, PCB handling, AMRs, and inline process-integration equipment. Together, these technologies form a connected automation ecosystem that allows manufacturers to achieve higher throughput, greater traceability, and long-term process optimization.

## About PROMATION USA

Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Kenosha, Wisconsin, PROMATION USA is a premier capital-equipment supplier specializing in automation solutions for the electronics and micro-electronics manufacturing industries. Its product portfolio includes PCB handling systems, robotic soldering, laser marking, robotic screw driving, robotic dispensing, AMR transport solutions, and technical furniture. With more than two decades of engineering excellence and a global customer base, PROMATION USA continues to lead the industry through innovation, reliability, and customer-driven design.

title: PROMATION Introduces QUICK 9394F Soldering Robot
author: PROMATION Inc.
excerpt: The QUICK 9394F features a 4-axis robotic gantry and 300mm x 300mm working area with upgraded 180-watt power supply and nitrogen-ready soldering iron for deeper temperature penetration.
body:
This month, PROMATION USA introduces the new 2020 QUICK 9394F Model Soldering Robot via PROMATIONmarketing's YouTube Channel.

The QUICK 9394F Soldering System features a 4-Axis Robotic Gantry and generous 300mm x 300mm Working Area. With an upgraded 180-Watt Power Supply and 180-Watt Nitrogen Ready Soldering Iron, the unit allows for deeper temperature penetration; while maintaining industry leading temperature stability throughout the soldering process.

Additional features include a newly redesigned solder feeding station that relocates the solder feeder to beneath the robot head. This in-turn allows the entire material spool and solder feeder to rotate with the Theta Axis reducing "pistoning" of material through the solder wire feed tube on applications that require additional head rotation.

The signature 9036 Solder Tip Correction Device has also been included on the 2020 model. This ingenious device allows for user to take solder tip measurements through the process and offset programs on-the-fly with just a click of a button.

Rounding out the QUICK 9394F is a dual rotating brass brush cleaning station, end effector fume extraction solution, and HD Digital Camera Kit; now available with an upgrade-able Aven Digital Microscope holster for video recording and magnified photo capture.

Additional system details can be found at: www.promationusa.com/9394f

title: PROMATION launches "Soldering Technology" Initiative
author: PROMATION Inc.
excerpt: PROMATION USA launches a "Soldering Technology Initiative" campaign designed to educate industry professionals about the latest technology being introduced into the world of soldering, including a complimentary solder spool perforation service.
body:
PROMATION USA - a world class supplier of capital equipment for micro-electronics manufacturers - has recently launched a "Soldering Technology Initiative" campaign designed to educate industry professionals about the latest technology being introduced into the world of soldering.

PROMATION has taken aim on electronics manufacturers in all industry sectors; to educate individuals and companies on the latest and greatest technologies taking place in the manufacturing industry.

To compliment a few of PROMATION USA's more recent accomplishments such as, the introduction of a new solder tip pressuring monitoring solution available on select robotic soldering systems, heated Nitrogen Kits for Lead-Free Soldering, and much more - PROMATION USA has looked to get companies and individuals (not yet ready to take the plunge into automatic or robotic soldering) to turn their attention towards technologies being used in these automated systems - now becoming available in the manual soldering marketplace.

One of the more recent services available through PROMATION USA, allows customers interested in improving their manual soldering process to take part in a complimentary service that allows companies or individuals to submit solder spools to PROMATION's PROlab for a "perforation service".

"The complimentary Solder Spool Perforation Service - Mike Goldberg of PROMATION USA states, gets people thinking about the applicability of these technologies in their common everyday practices".

The concept behind solder wire perforation is to perforate or score the flux-cored solder wire to allow for an improved out-gassing of the inner flux core.

During the soldering process, the flux that has been extruded into the core of the solder wire, performs a specific task of removing oxidation on solder pads and solder leads to prepare the parental substrates for the formation of an inter-metallic bond. Flux, however, is flammable and secretes gasses during this process that can lead to a multitude of different results or faults such as: Solder Joint Pin-holes, Solder Ball Defects, Flux Splatter, and non-activated flux being left on the solder joint.

"The driving theory behind peripheral perforation devices is that they allow the gasses created during the solder process to escape more efficiently reducing defects and allow for an improved bond to form," continues Mike Goldberg. "The fact that companies and individuals are turned-off from exploring these technologies due to the perceived notion that they are only available on robotic solutions is a serious mistake. Many of our current customers and solder wire suppliers have provided incredible data and feedback on the performance of these types of solutions and we are delighted to now have the opportunity to present these technologies at an affordable and easily attainable price."

Complimentary services like these are designed to open the eyes of industry professionals and remind everyone that there are a plethora of emerging technologies that offer solutions to common well-known industry problems.

"Perforation technology is well on its way to becoming a common technology practice among electronics manufacturers; as its benefits are easily seen and documented during lab testing and real world applications," concludes Mike Goldberg.

PROMATION USA features a full line of perforation technology products - not just on the robotic soldering side - but also on the manual/ hand soldering spectrum.

Perforation Products Include: The QUICK 300 Series Perforation and Respool Station, the QUICK 376DI Semi-Automatic Soldering Station, QUICK 372B Table-Top Perforation Solder Feed Station, and many more.

For more information on solder wire perforation technologies and application specific inquires, please contact PROMATION USA direct at: 1.262.764.4832

While continuing to offer "Lowest Cost of Ownership" in its class, the new TS Series Hand Soldering Stations offer new and improved ergonomic hand pieces with full network capability. The Online Software package allows end-users the ability to monitor up to 100 Hand Soldering Stations from a networked PC Interface.

Online Monitoring of the TS Series Hand Soldering Stations offers a multitude of benefits to electronics manufactures. A few new features have been included such as: Real-Time Temperature Curve Charts with "Easy-Share" features for advanced data logging of manufacturing processes / cycles. In addition, an integrated 12-month calendar allows users to review historical temperature curve charts; while offering users export options and "Easy-Share" print features. Benefits to the online monitoring solution include: Improved Regiments for Spare Parts Ordering and Issuance to the Production Line, Reduced Down-time - as a result of better scheduled preventative maintenance regiments, and overall improved process stability.

Additional features to the online monitoring software package includes: Password Protection Options, Temperature Lock-Out Functions, Remote Line Control, ESD Protection / Testing Options, and more.

title: PROMATION USA — New Products for 2019!
author: PROMATION Inc.
excerpt: PROMATION USA announces three major product launches for 2019: the PRO 4.0 Intelligent Line Control Solution, the QUICK 9544CJ PRO Model soldering robot, and the LM-400 High Speed Laser Marking Workstation.
body:
PROMATION USA announced three major product launches for 2019, all scheduled to debut at the 2019 IPC APEX Expo in San Diego.

## PRO 4.0 Intelligent Line Control Solution

A redesigned PCB handling system featuring a user interface where operators can select jobs, determine run/job counts, and have the entire SMT Line changeover at the touch of a button. The system integrates both networked and non-networked equipment. A forthcoming PRO 4.1 version will utilize network protocols instead of SMEMA standards.

## QUICK 9544CJ PRO Model Soldering Robot

The largest flexible robotic soldering workstation available, featuring a 500mm x 500mm working area, 180-Watt eddy current heating system, and dual solder tip cleaning stations. The equipment targets contract manufacturers prioritizing flexibility and return on investment.

## LM-400 High Speed Laser Marking Workstation

A redesigned marking system emphasizing speed and compact footprint with a movable laser head. An optional barcode scanning conveyor enables automatic part tracking and network integration.
